source.note: The Python backend, ingestion, and frontend images were built from HEAD. The tracked changes are the benchmark harness setup-path setting, the Docker ignore entry for the Rust build output, and the Git ignore entries that keep the Rust lockfile tracked; the Rust slice is untracked work in apps/studio/backend-rs.
source.commit: The runs measured an uncommitted measurement slice on top of repository_head. That work was first committed in pull request mdrideout/junjo#43, branch studio-rust-backend, after it had grown into the full backend; the slice itself has no commit.

resource_profile.mixed-proxy: 0.45 CPU each plus a 0.10 CPU counting proxy
resource_profile.single-cpu whole stack (variants ending: both services pinned to CPU 0 with no individual CPU quota; 450 MiB and 350 MiB, no swap

harness.note: One call in the harness was re-wrapped by the formatter after the runs. The diagnostic patch still applies, and the patched file differs from the one that ran only in that line's layout.

conditions.load: a sibling container running four busy loops (--cpus 4) for the whole batch
conditions.load, variants ending in -shared: the same load container, pinned to CPUs 4-7 so it cannot run on the measured CPU
conditions.repetition names starting with idle: the period observed before ingestion, in seconds, when it is not the default 20

run_order: Python and Rust runs were interleaved within every batch; recorded_at_utc in summary.json gives the order.
raw_results: Not committed. The raw JSON and service logs of each run are kept locally in results/, which Git ignores.
